Description: Get users to 'aha moment' in <5 minutes. Map shortest path from signup to first value. Remove every step that doesn't serve this goal.
Do_This: Map: signup → first action → aha moment → habit|Remove unnecessary form fields|Celebrate first success|Send follow-up if user stalls|Day 1 email: 1 action to do
Warning_Signs: No onboarding (users figure it out)|Too many steps before value|Asking for info you don't need yet|No follow-up for inactive users

Description: Composite score (0-100) combining: usage frequency (40%), feature adoption (20%), support tickets (20%), NPS/feedback (20%). Predicts churn.
Do_This: Define 4-6 health indicators|Weight by churn correlation|Score: Green (70-100) Yellow (40-69) Red (0-39)|Review weekly|Auto-alert on score drops|Personal outreach for Red accounts
Warning_Signs: No health scoring (flying blind)|Only using 1 indicator|Not acting on Yellow/Red accounts|Quarterly review (too slow)

Description: Detect churn signals 30-60 days before cancellation. Intervene early. Signals: decreased login frequency, support tickets, feature drop-off.
Do_This: Monitor: login frequency trend, support volume, feature usage, billing failures|Auto-trigger when 2+ signals fire|Personal outreach within 48 hours|Offer: 1:1 call, extended trial, plan adjustment|Document save/lose reasons
Warning_Signs: Reacting after cancellation (too late)|No early warning system|Generic automated emails for at-risk|Not tracking why customers leave

Description: Automated lifecycle emails: Day 0 (welcome), Day 1 (quick win), Day 3 (advanced feature), Day 7 (community), Day 14 (feedback ask), Day 30 (upgrade).
Do_This: 6 emails in first 30 days|Each email = ONE clear CTA|Segment by activation status|Stop sequence when user activates|Ask for feedback at Day 14|Include unsubscribe
Warning_Signs: Too many emails (>2/week)|No segmentation (same emails for active and inactive)|No CTA (informational only)|Continuing to send after user is activated
Metrics: Open Rate|Click Rate|Activation Rate by sequence step

Description: For top accounts: quarterly meeting reviewing value delivered, goals achieved, roadmap alignment. Ties product to customer's business outcomes.
Do_This: Share usage metrics before meeting|Show ROI (value delivered vs cost)|Align on next quarter goals|Identify expansion opportunities|Include customer's executive sponsor
Warning_Signs: Only discussing features/bugs|No executive involvement|No value metrics prepared|Ad-hoc instead of scheduled
Metrics: QBR Completion Rate|Expansion from QBR accounts|Renewal Rate for QBR accounts

Description: 80% of questions should be answerable without contacting support. Build knowledge base from top 20 support tickets. Use Intercom, Crisp, or Notion.
Do_This: Analyze top 20 support tickets|Write article for each|Add to product (in-app help widget)|Track: article views, thumbs up/down, search queries|Update monthly based on new tickets
Warning_Signs: No knowledge base at all|Outdated articles|Not tracking effectiveness|Hidden knowledge base (hard to find in product)
Metrics: Self-Service Rate|Support Ticket Volume|KB Article Satisfaction Score

Description: Monthly NPS survey to gauge satisfaction. Follow up with detractors (0-6) within 24 hours. Track promoters (9-10) as referral candidates.
Do_This: In-app NPS survey monthly|Sample: 10-20% of active users|Follow up every detractor personally|Track NPS trend monthly|Close the loop (tell customers you fixed their feedback)
Warning_Signs: Annual surveys (too infrequent)|No follow-up on detractors|Not closing the feedback loop|Using NPS as vanity metric without action
Metrics: NPS Score|Response Rate|Detractor Follow-up Rate|Trend over time

Description: Systematic approach to growing revenue from existing customers. Trigger-based: usage limits, new features, team growth, business event.
Do_This: Define expansion triggers: 80% usage, new team member, feature request for premium|Create upgrade page in product|Personal outreach for top accounts|Track expansion revenue separately|Celebrate customer growth
Warning_Signs: Only waiting for customer to ask|No upgrade triggers in product|Aggressive upselling (damages relationship)|No tracking of expansion revenue
